loginSubtitle: Access your PR Per Hour client account to manage your profile and stay connected with the team.
registerSubtitle: Public registration creates a client account only. Administrator accounts are provisioned separately.
verifyEmailSubtitle: Enter the six-digit code we sent to your email to activate your account.
forgotPasswordSubtitle: Enter your email and we will send a reset code if an account exists for that address.
resetPasswordSubtitle: Enter the six-digit code from your email and choose a new password.
passwordHint: At least 10 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, and a number.
verifyEmailCodeSentHint: If a code was sent, it should arrive shortly. You can resend after the countdown.
verifyEmailSendFailedHint: Your account was created, but the verification email could not be sent. Use Resend code below.
verifyEmailResent: A new verification code has been sent.
forgotPasswordGenericSuccess: If an account exists for that email, a reset code has been sent.
emailVerifiedSuccess: Email verified successfully. Please sign in.
passwordResetSuccess: Password reset successfully. Please sign in again.
emailVerificationRequired: Please verify your email before signing in. A verification code can be requested on the next screen.
inactiveAccount: This account is inactive. Please contact support.
unauthorizedDescription: You do not have permission to view this page. You can return home or sign in with a different account.
benefitsLead: Sign in to manage your profile, explore our services, and contact the consultancy team directly.
benefitsItem1: Client accounts are created only through public registration
benefitsItem3: Your account stays linked to your inquiries and profile details
